title: Read Articles with Me
text:
Preface
This book is a record of reading research papers one at a time, understanding their core ideas, and replicating them as simply as possible.

title: Read Articles with Me
text:
How each chapter is organized
Each chapter covers one paper and follows the same structure:

Paper at a glance: citation, one-line summary, and why it is worth reading
Background: the minimum context needed to follow the paper
Core idea: the key method, explained intuitively
Replication: a simple reproduction using simulated or public data
Takeaways: what we learned, limitations, and further reading

title: Read Articles with Me
text:
Replication principles

The goal is not a perfect reproduction of every number, but to confirm the direction and mechanism of the main result.
Every chapter’s code runs end to end as written.
Random seeds are fixed wherever randomness is involved.

1.4 Replication

1.4.1 Setup


Code
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

y = 1.0 + 2.0 * x + rng.normal(scale=1.0, size=n)

1.4.3 Analysis


Code
beta1, beta0 = np.polyfit(df["x"], df["y"], 1)
plt.scatter(df["x"], df["y"], alpha=0.5)
grid = np.linspace(df["x"].min(), df["x"].max(), 100)
plt.plot(grid, beta0 + beta1 * grid)
plt.xlabel("x"); plt.ylabel("y")
plt.show()
